scope: Envelope models for U2301 (W25Q128JW WSON-8 8x6) and U1710 (TPS23730 RMT VQFN). C1723/C1729 moved to stock CP_Elec footprints with stock models, J1201 to a stock USB-C footprint with its stock model. Remaining holds need vendor CAD (RJ45, magnetics, SIM, Q1706, WE-SL5) or are bare-copper / mechanical footprints.

attached.source:
W25Q128JWEIQ WSON-8 8x6 (Winbond package code E, same outline as the stock KiCad
WSON-8-1EP_8x6mm_P1.27mm_EP3.4x4.3mm land): D 8.00 (x) x E 6.00 (y) nominal, A 0.80 max; terminals
and the 3.4 x 4.3 exposed pad modelled at the footprint's own copper shrunk 0.1 per side. Pin 1 top-left.

TPS23730 RMT0045A VQFN-45: 5.00 (x) x 7.00 (y) nominal per the TI PMP22477 footprint's body outline,
A 1.00 max (TI VQFN family); terminals and the two thermal pads at the footprint copper shrunk 0.05 per
side. Pin 1 top-left (-2.4, -2.6).

remaining_holds.blocker: Molex 1042240820 hinged/cover geometry and insertion clearance require exact vendor CAD and seating datum; no verified asset obtained.
Pulse HX4110NL drawing is archived; transformer body, stand-off and lead bend need a matching model; installed stock path is absent.
Amphenol RJE49 drawing archived; no exact CAD obtained. RJ45 substitutes have different panel, shield-tab and LED geometry.
FDMS86252 exact Power56/PQFN terminal arrangement and seating geometry need vendor package CAD; generic eight-pin QFN is not sufficient.
Wurth publishes the exact 744272251 STEP (WE-SL5), but automated retrieval returns HTTP 403 and the KiCad 10.99 install ships no STEP for this stock footprint; needs a manual download.
Bare copper pads and leg holes for a Tag-Connect TC2030-IDC cable; no component is fitted, so there is nothing to model.
Plated M2 hold-down for the M.2 card; the standoff/screw is mechanical hardware, not a fitted component.
